subject.title: feat(ios): durable offline command outbox for chat sends

question: Is the bounded text-only iOS durable outbox storage and replay contract acceptable for v1 once the mechanical blockers and real iOS proof are fixed, or should this wait for a broader mobile text/voice privacy contract?
rationale: The branch stores private user-authored commands for later Gateway delivery and intentionally narrows the canonical issue to text-only iOS, so automation cannot choose the privacy, retention, replay, and staged-scope boundary for maintainers.

options.title: Accept text-only v1 after fixes
options.body: Require the FIFO/lint/i18n fixes plus redacted real behavior proof, then allow the bounded text-only iOS outbox to proceed as the staged implementation.

options.title: Hold for broader contract
options.body: Pause this branch until maintainers approve a cross-platform text/voice outbox contract covering privacy, background sync, queue review, and retention.

options.title: Narrow to experiment
options.body: Keep the implementation out of user-facing release positioning until security and UX expectations are settled.

recommendation.title: Accept text-only v1 after fixes
recommendation.body: Require the FIFO/lint/i18n fixes plus redacted real behavior proof, then allow the bounded text-only iOS outbox to proceed as the staged implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete owns the active stacked iOS cache/outbox work and has the strongest recent history on the affected shared chat path.
